obtainedAt.value: Wild encounters across Paldea (including outbreaks); also available via picnic eggs from a Ditto parent pair.

bottleCap.value: Tera Raids and Porto Marinada auctions once you are deep into postgame progression

goldBottleCap.value: Accumulators auction listings and rare special rewards

how.value: Keep hunting wild encounters, Tera Raids, and outbreaks until the target nature appears — Synchronize no longer forces wild natures in Scarlet/Violet. Once you have one parent with that nature, picnic eggs from it (with an Everstone) are the reliable route.

femaleDeterminesSpecies.value: The female parent determines the offspring's species.

withDitto.value: With a Ditto pair, the non-Ditto parent determines the offspring's species.

hidden.value: Catch one with the hidden ability (outbreaks, Tera Raids, or random wild encounters), or apply an Ability Patch to a parent that already has a standard ability.

how.value: Catch or hatch one that already knows the move, or copy it at a picnic with a Mirror Herb.
You may already have one — a Japanese Charmander with an English Ditto would count. Otherwise trade for one, or import from a cartridge saved in another language.

effect.value: Raises how often eggs appear in the picnic basket — Lv. 3 is about 10× egg-find chance; Lv. 2 is the practical everyday target from shop ingredients. · Shortens the steps needed to hatch eggs while active.

availability.value: Cook at a picnic. Lv. 2 recipes use common shop ingredients (for example a Great Peanut Butter Sandwich). Lv. 3 needs Herba Mystica from 5★+ Tera Raids.

eggEfficiencyModifiers.name: Flame Body (or Magma Armor / Steam Engine) in party

effect.value: Halves the steps needed to hatch eggs while that Pokémon is in your party.

availability.value: Any party slot. These abilities do not stack with each other — one holder is enough.

place.value: South Province (Areas One, Three–Five) and West Province Area Three
Area Zero and North Province Area Two

effect.value: Eggs hatch from steps taken. Cover ground on your ride legendary — that is the fast path.

availability.value: Hatch progress stops while climbing, gliding, or flying, so stay on the ground. Keep at least one non-egg Pokémon in the party.

howItWorks.value: Held during a picnic, it copies egg moves from a partner that already knows them.

Dragon Dance.value: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by one stage each.

Blaze.value: When this Pokémon's HP is at or below one-third, the power of its Fire-type moves is boosted.

Solar Power.value: In harsh sunlight, Special Attack rises, but the Pokémon loses some HP at the end of each turn.

hatchMechanicExplainer.value: Eggs show up in the picnic basket while two compatible Pokémon are in your party picnic. Egg Power sandwiches raise how often eggs appear and also shorten hatch time — Lv. 2 from shop ingredients is the everyday target; Lv. 3 needs Herba Mystica from 5★+ Tera Raids and is roughly 10× the base find rate. A party Pokémon with Flame Body, Magma Armor, or Steam Engine halves remaining hatch cycles (abilities do not stack with each other). Hatch by covering ground on Koraidon or Miraidon — stay on the ground, and keep at least one non-egg Pokémon in the party.
